title: Rust-TOPS gate report
description: The report `cargo tops gate` writes to <target>/rust-tops/report.json on every run: a pass, a failure, a dry run, a missing tool, and a config error once the target is known.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version of the cargo-tops that wrote the report.

crate.description: crate.name from rust-tops.yaml; the directory name when the config did not load.

git_sha.description: HEAD of the target; absent outside a git repository.

kind.description: What decided the exit code. Where more than one applies, config-invalid wins over environment, and environment over fail.

exit_code.description: 0 pass; 1 the gate ran and failed (a dry run included); 2 the config is invalid; 3 the environment (a required tool or cargo metadata is missing).

error.description: Why the gate stopped before a verdict (exit codes 2 and 3 with no run).

problems.description: Every problem, one line each. Empty exactly when ok.

count.description: The `count:` line of the run; null when nothing was judged.

layers.description: One row per enabled layer, in rust-tops.yaml order.

argv.description: Each command of the layer, as an argv list, in order.

tool_version.description: The first line the tool's --version printed; null when not asked or not found.

took_from.description: The layer whose run this layer took, when it has no command of its own.

judged.description: The floors and the measured values the layer was judged on.

disabled.description: Layers turned off with enabled: false.

laws.description: The laws as cases.json has them: the same status, verdict and reason code. Empty when bend did not run.
